title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Advanced review set explorer for KQL analysis (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the cost rationale incorrectly puts premium licensing on reviewers, although Microsoft's permissions page exempts case-member administrators, compliance officers and legal personnel from needing E5. The change note also says licensing is unstated despite documented premium eDiscovery entitlement; the claim that the explorer adds no data store goes beyond the published description.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Queries use the current review set's indexed items rather than a newly selected data source.
claims.quote: All queries in the Advanced review set explorer (preview) run against the current review set's indexed items. You don't need to specify a table name. The review set acts as the default data source.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Adding data to a review set can change results between query runs.
claims.quote: Results reflect the current indexed state of the review set. If you add more data to the review set, the query might return different results.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft's sample queries expand participants and count items associated with each participant.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: The explorer is not a new data store.
claims.quote: Searched: "Advanced review set explorer" "store" "data"; opened edisc-review-set-explorer, edisc, edisc-workflow and edisc-billing. They describe indexed review set queries, not whether the explorer introduces any storage.
claims.fix: Replace 'This is a reviewer-productivity change inside an existing eDiscovery workflow, not a new data store.' with 'This is a reviewer-productivity change that runs queries against the current review set's indexed items.'

claims.where: Why it matters

claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-features-components to sources for the statement that the condition builder and explorer work on the same review set content.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
